devon: Quick sync  We have a regulator request that needs a cross-account SIEM export for a legal-hold investigation. Files are KMS-encrypted. Constraints: (1) external auditor account must be allowed to read a narrow prefix for 72h, (2) no persistent copies outside our vault, (3) all decrypts must be provably tied to the ticket id. Ideas?
anya: We should avoid long-lived grants. Option A: create a cross-account assume-role in the auditor account with a resource-scoped policy + require MFA and `aws:PrincipalOrgID` (if they are in a partner org). TTL 72h but auto-revoke after 72h. For KMS, use an intermediate key (data key wrapper) or a grant with EncryptionContext containing ticket id.
paul-sec: Important: do not add the auditor to the CMK key policy. Use CreateGrant to the log-proxy role that the auditor assumes via STS (via our proxy). The proxy will enforce no-persist by mounting a write-only channel to the auditor and streaming only, plus block s3:PutObject and PutObjectTagging for the auditor principal.
hannah-compliance: Compliance wrinkle: legal wants retention to be extended for these objects beyond the normal lifecycle until investigation closes, but they also require proof no external copies were made. Can we set object retention flags but prevent tag changes?
anya: Yes. Set object lock governance (WORM) with retention-until=investigation-end on the object's retention header. Deny s3:PutObjectRetention, s3:PutObjectTagging, and s3:DeleteObject for the auditor role. For the temporary retention extension, require a signed approval (Jira ticket with compliance signoff) to flip retention date. That keeps an auditable trail.
paul-sec: To prove decrypts: require EncryptionContext {"ticket":"REG-2026-12"} and have the proxy log GrantId, principal, encryption-context, source IP, and sha256 of the plaintext to security-audit before returning data. Also ensure CloudTrail captures kms:Decrypt and send CloudTrail logs to a locked audit bucket.
inhfra-bot: Action: provision cross-account assume-role scaffold: role redwood-auditor-assume-REG-2026-12 (72h TTL) + provision KMS grant to log-proxy, create object-retention tag on target prefix. Pending manual approval.
infra-bot: Resources provisioned: s3://legal-hold/REG-2026-12/, role redwood-auditor-assume-REG-2026-12 (expires 72h), grant G-0a1b2c3d created.
hannah-compliance: Approving provision. Two conditions before handoff: (1) verification job runs after revoke to scan CloudTrail + S3 access logs for any GETs from non-approved IPs, (2) compliance radio log entry stating: "No raw copies persisted externally; retention extended under legal hold; CMK decrypts logged (GrantId G-0a1b2c3d)".
devon: Thanks all. I'll open a short runbook PR showing step-by-step: grant creation, proxy logging contract, retention extension flow, and post-revoke verification query. Will tag compliance for review.
